task.title: Monitoring Your System
task.shortdesc: Monitor Powerwall 3 system operation from your mobile device using the Tesla app.

context.p: The Tesla app allows you to monitor the following from your mobile device:

ul.li: Relative amounts of energy used from solar, grid, and Powerwall storage

step.cmd: Download the latest version of the Tesla app from tesla.com/support/tesla-app.
Open the Tesla app on your mobile device and sign in to your Tesla account.
Select your Powerwall system from the home screen to view system operation.
step.stepresult: The app displays real-time power usage, energy consumption history, and relative amounts of energy used from solar, grid, and Powerwall storage.
